about.bio:
Paid media specialist with 9+ years running Google Ads, Shopping, and Meta for e-commerce brands. I manage $60M+ in annual ad spend and operate as an embedded specialist, someone who owns the accounts and the results, not a vendor managing from a distance.

I work across the full funnel from prospecting to retargeting, with deep hands-on work in GA4, GTM, and server-side tracking. Most revenue leakage I see comes from broken attribution, not bad bidding.

Available for direct retainer engagements with US-based brands.
focus: Full-funnel paid media across Google, Meta, and YouTube
Search, Shopping, and PMax at scale
Conversion tracking and attribution across GA4 and GTM
Retargeting and audience strategy tied to revenue
